title: Key invariant `infinite_from P l` for the constructive Weak König's Lemma
intent: Prove a constructive Weak König's Lemma: from `infinite_from P []` (arbitrarily long P-avoiding paths above []) plus a De Morgan decidability hypothesis, exhibit a predicate `X` with `has_infinite_path P`. The single idea is the strengthened invariant `infinite_from P l` for an arbitrary prefix `l`, which the glue asserts and proves by induction on `l`, dispatching each case to six named lemmas.

parent.name: PreWeakKonigsLemma
parent.statement:
Theorem PreWeakKonigsLemma : forall P,
  demorgan_inductively_barred_at P -> infinite_from P [] -> has_infinite_path P.

children.name: is_path_from_restrict
children.statement:
Lemma is_path_from_restrict : forall P n n' l, n <= n' ->
  is_path_from P n' l -> is_path_from P n l.
children.closed_by: induction H on is_path_from P n' l; each constructor case closes by destruct n and apply here / next_left / next_right after Nat.le_0_r or Nat.succ_le_mono

children.name: inductively_barred_at_monotone
children.statement:
Lemma inductively_barred_at_monotone : forall P l n n', n' <= n ->
  inductively_barred_at P n' l -> inductively_barred_at P n l.
children.closed_by: induction Hbar on inductively_barred_at P n' l, then now_at / propagate_at (with Nat.nle_succ_0 and Nat.succ_le_mono)

children.name: inductively_barred_at_imp_is_path_from
children.statement:
Lemma inductively_barred_at_imp_is_path_from :
  forall P, demorgan_inductively_barred_at P -> forall n l,
  ~ inductively_barred_at P n l -> is_path_from P n l.
children.closed_by: induction n; base case here + now_at; step case Hdemorgan + IHn + auto using is_path_from

children.name: find_left_path
children.statement:
Lemma find_left_path : forall P l n,
  is_path_from P (S n) l -> inductively_barred_at P n (false :: l) -> is_path_from P n (true :: l).
children.closed_by: inversion 1 on is_path_from P (S n) l; first case auto, second case exfalso; eauto using is_path_from_imp_inductively_barred_at

children.name: Y_unique
children.statement:
Lemma Y_unique : forall P, demorgan_inductively_barred_at P ->
  forall l1 l2, length l1 = length l2 -> Y P l1 -> Y P l2 -> l1 = l2.
children.closed_by: induction l1, l2; f_equal; the (true,false) and (false,true) cases close by destructing is_path_from_imp_inductively_barred_at

children.name: Y_approx
children.statement:
Lemma Y_approx : forall P, demorgan_inductively_barred_at P ->
  forall l, approx (X P) l -> Y P l.
children.closed_by: induction l; the b=true case rewrites with Y_unique, the b=false case applies inductively_barred_at_imp_is_path_from

applicability.goal_shape: A goal of the form has_infinite_path P, i.e. exists X, forall l, approx X l -> ~ P l, over two dual inductive relations (is_path_from P n l and inductively_barred_at P n l); proved by strengthening the given instance infinite_from P [] to the invariant forall l, infinite_from P l and inducting on the prefix l.
applicability.use_when: The conclusion is an existential over an infinite object (a path/stream represented as a predicate over finite prefixes), and the hypotheses pin one finite instance ([] here) that a restriction/monotonicity lemma can reduce an arbitrary prefix to; a De Morgan hypothesis (demorgan_inductively_barred_at P) is available to move between the 'barred' and 'path' forms.
applicability.avoid_when: The invariant cannot be stated as a single predicate over prefixes, or no decidability/De Morgan hypothesis links the 'barred' and 'path' directions, or the prefix set Y is not unique so the rewrite that re-targets the bound cannot go through.

consequences: The move creates one strengthened-invariant obligation: the glue must prove infinite_from P l for every l, not just [], so the induction step splits on the next bit a (true/false) and, in the true case, on the bound comparison le_lt_dec n n' to choose between is_path_from_restrict (n <= n') and inductively_barred_at_monotone (n' < n). Every lemma that reasons across the two dual predicates (is_path_from vs inductively_barred_at) rests on their no-overlap lemma is_path_from_imp_inductively_barred_at. Failure modes: without demorgan_inductively_barred_at P the false-case of Y_approx and the step of inductively_barred_at_imp_is_path_from cannot close; without Y_unique the rewrite in the true case that re-targets the bound to the current prefix does not go through.
